ai_summary: Adani Green Energy Limited (AGEL) has announced a Board meeting on October 21, 2026, to consider and approve its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. This routine disclosure includes a trading window closure from October 1st to October 23rd, and an investor/analyst call scheduled for October 22nd to discuss the financial performance and business outlook. No red flags are apparent, as this is a standard regulatory announcement preceding a company's earnings release.
